import subprocess,time,collections
t=time.time()
o=subprocess.run('python3 csvsum.py<d.csv',shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
e=time.time()-t
s=collections.defaultdict(float)
for l in open('d.csv').read().split('\n')[1:-1]:

ref=''.join('%s %.2f\n'%(k,s[k]) for k in sorted(s))
print(1/e if o==ref and len(s)==50 else 0)
